reviews.title: It connected instantly with no pairing involved
reviews.comment: These sound amazing, very easy to connect. I plugged the usb-c into my laptop, turned the headset on. That’s all I had to do. I would 100% recommend these to anyone who asks what headsets they should get. Money well spent!!!
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Solid wireless headset for the price.
reviews.comment: Works great on my PS5 and my Portal. The dual wireless modes are handy, I use the dongle for gaming (very small lag) and Bluetooth for my phone at the same time. Sound is descent, not amazing but definitely solid for gaming. Love how lightweight it is, and the ear pads are super comfy for long sessions. Battery lasts about 12 hours at least depending on which mode you use. The flip-to-mute mic works fine and my friends hear me clearly. Overall a great everyday headset if you play on multiple devices.
reviews.author: Marcelo

reviews.title: Thought they where broken at first, but you just need to attach the ears to the headband.
reviews.comment: First off I thought they where broken when I got them, I notice both the left, and right ear's weren't connected to the head band. Then I notice you have to put there where you want them on the head band. I've been using a Razer Kraken Ultimate, then switched to the Razer BlackShark V2 Hyperspeed Wireless headset. So using the two Razer headsets to compare with the RIG 600 PRO HS Dual Wireless headset is what I will be doing. So for starters the headband is plastic, I don't trust plastic headbands because they can break very easy. The RIG 600 PRO HS is no exception, however if it breaks, just get a new headband, they have made it so you can change it out very easy, just need to release the band part from the plastic, and transfer it over to a new one. The RIG 600 PRO HS does weigh less than the Razer BlackShark V2 Hyperspeed headset. However, the Razer one can last longer, and is louder. But the RIG 600 PRO HS has base to back it up, what do I mean? You can hear, and feel the base, while in the Razer one you have to tweak stuff around which can be an issue if you just want to go and play. The RIG 600 PRO HS doesn't have PC software, only Apple/Android software to connect to your headset, and check for firmware updates. The dongle they provide is small, and it comes with a small USB to type c cable. The mic is hidden in the left ear cup, and is hard to take out if you don't pay attention to the instructions, you just need to push on the bottom to have the mic to come out. The mic has good sound quality, and nice noise cancellation. You also have three buttons, and volume wheel on the left ear cup. One is for power, another for connectivity (blue tooth, 2.4ghz (the dongle)), and the other is for the different types of sound settings, which you can add/change via your smart phone app. This headset is light weight, so light that I throw them on when heading outside to do whatever. Perfect headset for gaming, listening to music, and whatever else you would use a gaming headset for.
reviews.author: LaocheXe

reviews.title: Immersive Audio and Comfort Across Every Platform
reviews.comment: gaming sessions. The standout feature is its dual wireless connectivity (2.4GHz + Bluetooth), which makes switching between my PlayStation, PC, and even mobile devices seamless. I can hop from a PS5 multiplayer match to a Switch co-op game without missing a beat. The audio quality is phenomenal—clear highs, deep bass, and a surround sound experience that makes every explosion, footstep, and in-game detail feel immersive. The memory foam ear cushions provide comfort during extended play sessions, and the headset is surprisingly lightweight, which prevents fatigue. The acid camo design adds a sleek, modern look that stands out in my gaming setup. Another feature I appreciate is the flexible and detachable microphone, which captures my voice clearly while minimizing background noise—perfect for team communication or streaming. Battery life is solid, allowing several hours of uninterrupted gaming, and the headset charges quickly via USB. Overall, the RIG 600 PRO HS is comfortable, versatile, and audio-rich, making it an excellent choice for serious gamers who want a headset that performs across multiple platforms without sacrificing style or comfort.
